description.value: JOEY Restaurants is a family-owned Canadian casual dining chain founded in 1992, known for globally and locally inspired cuisine developed by a team of Executive Chefs. The Bentall One location occupies a prominent spot in Vancouver's downtown financial core on Burrard Street, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. The menu spans globally inspired dishes including sushi, steak, and craft cocktails in a modern, casual atmosphere.
